notes:
Mid-market product org building a B2B search + recommendations layer for their analytics SaaS. Primary goal: improve top-k relevance for product search and in-product content surfacing by adding a lightweight reranking endpoint. Current stack: Elastic for retrieval, custom feature scoring for business signals. Exploring Redwood hosted API as quick POC for rerank stage, then move to Dedicated if latency/cost profile is acceptable. POC scope: 1) integrate hosted rerank API to score 100 candidates, 2) offline eval on historical query set (~150k queries) with metrics MRR/NDCG@5/10, 3) live A/B in subset of customers for 2 weeks.

Key performance targets from Head of Product: p95 latency <= 200ms for rerank endpoint (end-to-end), throughput target ~300 qps during business hours (burst to 800), restartable batch offline scoring that can run overnight. Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for Dedicated if unit economics clearly improve vs hosted with predictable commit. Model preferences: prefer open weights (Llama 2 / community quantized variants), but want Redwood-verified performance profile and a guaranteed fallback to smaller model when load spikes. Need support for prefix/KV caching and candidate-level scoring (accepts list of candidate doc ids + features).

Security/compliance: require SSO (SAML), KMS-based key management for customer payloads, audit logging for inference calls, and the option for VPC peering for Dedicated. Data residency: prefer NA, but some customers require EU residency — flag for routing policy. Quote from Head of Product: "If we can't get predictable cost per query and a clean offline eval pipeline, we won't commit to Dedicated".
